reading.body:
This facility has no published power specification, no identified operator, and no accessible technical documentation. The registry could not resolve the company name, address, or business status through available search methods, leaving it unverifiable as an active data center.

Arizona has 56 mapped facilities in this registry, of which only four publish power figures totaling 512 MW. Without a published specification, this campus cannot be ranked against the state's disclosed capacity or assessed for AI workload suitability.

The facility remains an open research item. Confirmation of operator identity, current status, and power infrastructure would be required before it could be evaluated as relevant to AI scaling.
